 Kure Beach hosting free Medicare information session 
 2027 Medicare Advantage Options (weau) By WECT Staff Published : Oct. 29, 2026 at 5:06 PM EDT | Updated : 1 hour ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google KURE BEACH, N.C. (WECT) - Medicare open enrollment is underway, and Kure Beach is hosting a free information session to help residents understand their coverage options.
 The Seniors’ Health Insurance Information Program (SHIIP) is leading the presentation at 7 p.m. on Nov. 5 at the Kure Beach Community Center. 
 SHIIP counselors will give an overview of Medicare Parts A, B and D. They will also explain Medicare Advantage and Medicare Supplement plans.
 The town says the session is free and open to the public.
